items.reason: A gentle, non-stripping cleanser suits skin that looks dry and low in moisture.
A gentle brightening cream that helps the look of uneven tone on the cheeks without the irritation risk of a strong peel.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to comfort dry-looking skin and support the skin barrier.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides helps keep dark-looking patches from appearing deeper in daylight.

response.routine_note: I left out the 30% peel and the 1% retinol because they are too strong a start for dry skin and deeper skin tones, which can be left with darker marks after irritation, so begin with cleanser, azelaic cream (every other night at first), moisturizer, and sunscreen every morning. If the patches are persistent, spreading, or changing, a dermatologist is the right person to see rather than a stronger product from us.
